<!--
  Written by Claude (an AI model made by Anthropic) at Tyler George's direction.

  The explore-mode page. The game is drawn on the <canvas> below by the
  JavaScript files in the explore/ folder, starting with explore/main.js.

  Everything that matters for getting around (the way back to the
  traditional site, and the list of places under the map) is ordinary
  HTML, so it works for screen readers and when JavaScript is off.
-->

[← Switch to traditional site](about.qmd){.btn .to-traditional}

::: {#game-area .game-area}
```{=html}
<!-- Shown only if JavaScript is off or broken; main.js hides it. -->
<p id="game-fallback">
  The walkable map needs JavaScript. Every place on it is listed below.
</p>

<!-- The game. It starts hidden; main.js reveals it once it is running.
     width/height must match VIEW_COLS x TILE and VIEW_ROWS x TILE in
     explore/config.js. tabindex="0" lets keyboard users Tab to it. -->
<canvas id="game-canvas" width="320" height="224" tabindex="0" hidden
  aria-label="Walkable pixel-art campus. Use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D to walk. Everything here is also available on the traditional site.">
</canvas>

<!-- Sits on top of the map until the visitor starts the game. -->
<button id="game-start-hint" type="button" hidden>
  Click here to start walking<br>
  <small>Move with the arrow keys or W A S D</small>
</button>

<!-- The pop-up shown when the player can reach something. panel.js fills
     in the text. aria-live makes screen readers read it out when it
     appears. -->
<div id="place-panel" aria-live="polite" hidden>
  <img id="place-image" alt="Preview of the website this leads to" hidden>
  <strong id="place-title"></strong>
  <span id="place-description"></span>
  <button id="place-enter" class="btn" type="button" hidden>Go inside (Enter)</button>
  <a id="place-link" class="btn" href="#">Open page</a>
</div>

<!-- The large pop-up for reading part of the regular site without
     leaving the game. reader.js fills it in. <dialog> is the browser's
     built-in pop-up: Esc closes it and the page behind is dimmed. -->
<dialog id="reader" aria-labelledby="reader-title">
  <div class="reader-bar">
    <strong id="reader-title"></strong>
    <button id="reader-close" class="btn" type="button">Close (Esc)</button>
  </div>
  <div id="reader-content"></div>
  <p class="reader-foot">
    <a id="reader-source" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open this on the regular site (new tab)</a>
  </p>
</dialog>

<!-- Says where the player is ("Outside", "Classroom"). main.js changes
     it when the player goes through a door; screen readers read it out. -->
<div id="scene-label" aria-live="polite">Outside</div>

<script type="module" src="explore/main.js"></script>
```
:::
